mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DAILY_BATCH_EXECUTION (job_name, business_date, status, owner_id, lease_token, lease_until, started_at) VALUES (#{jobName}, #{businessDate}, #{status}, #{ownerId}, #{leaseToken}, #{leaseUntil}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE DAILY_BATCH_EXECUTION SET status = #{execution.status}, owner_id = #{execution.ownerId}, lease_token = #{execution.leaseToken}, lease_until = #{execution.leaseUntil}, started_at = #{execution.startedAt}, completed_at = NULL, error_summary = NULL WHERE job_name = #{execution.jobName} AND business_date = #{execution.businessDate} AND (status != 'RUNNING' OR lease_until < #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT daily_batch_execution_id AS id, job_name AS jobName, business_date AS businessDate, status, owner_id AS ownerId, lease_token AS leaseToken, lease_until AS leaseUntil, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, error_summary AS errorSummary, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM DAILY_BATCH_EXECUTION WHERE job_name = #{jobName} AND business_date = #{businessDate}
